subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Five nights in 4-star hotels in Yichang and Wuhan, flying in and out via Guangzhou with China Southern Airlines. Cruise Xiling Gorge, ride the Three Gorges Sky Road, visit Water Town in Dream, East Lake, the Sky Train and Yellow Crane Tower (outside view). There are no shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 11–16 2026 to Jan 19–24 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Yichang
items: Fly Manila to Guangzhou (CZ3092 12:00/14:40), then Guangzhou to Yichang (CZ3311 21:30/23:15).
Meet the English-speaking guide at Yichang airport; drive to hotel. Meals: X/X/X.

itinerary.title: Yichang
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Cruise trip through Xiling Gorge.
Three Gorges Sanyou Cave and Three Gorges Sky Road (Xiling Gorge section, panoramic viewing platform).
Yichang CBD Night Market.
Optional tour: Bailihuang Snowfield (snow play included; skiing costs extra). Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Yichang – Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Water Town in Dream (water forest cruise included).
Transfer to Wuhan.
Optional tour: Jingzhou Ancient City Wall (Binyang Tower, round-trip shuttle bus included); in flowering season, Jingzhou Large Plum Garden. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit East Lake Scenic Area.
Ride the Sky Train.
Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street and Night Market.
Optional tour: AI robot + flower blossom viewing at Xiaozhuwan + night tour of Jiangxia Lane. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Qingchuan Pavilion Scenic Area and Nan’anzui Two Rivers Confluence.
Wuchang Bay and Yellow Crane Tower (exterior view).
Hanzheng Street Small Commodities Wholesale Market.
Jianghan Customs and Lihuangpi Road; photo spots at Bagong House and Riverside Garden.
Optional tour: Han-style show with high-tech water show and traditional Chinese acrobatics. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Wuhan – Guangzhou – Manila
items: Breakfast and check out.
Transfer to the airport; fly Wuhan to Guangzhou (CZ6590 09:30/11:30), then Guangzhou to Manila (CZ397 14:15/16:50). Meals: B/X/X.

placeDesc.Xiling Gorge: The easternmost of the Yangtze's Three Gorges, near Yichang, explored on a cruise.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Sanyou Cave: A scenic cave and gorge site above the Yangtze near Yichang, reached on this tour with the Sky Road.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Sky Road: A cliffside walkway along the Xiling Gorge section with a panoramic viewing platform.
placeDesc.Yichang CBD Night Market: An evening market area in central Yichang with street food and local snacks.
placeDesc.Water Town in Dream: A scenic area near Yichang with waterways and a water-forest cruise, included in this tour.
placeDesc.East Lake: Wuhan's large urban lake scenic area, with lakeside paths, gardens and views.
placeDesc.Sky Train: A suspended sightseeing train at Wuhan's East Lake Scenic Area, ridden for lake views.
placeDesc.Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street: Wuhan's busy downtown pedestrian shopping street, with a night market.
placeDesc.Qingchuan Pavilion: A traditional pavilion beside the Yangtze in Wuhan, with views of the river and Wuhan skyline.
placeDesc.Nan’anzui: The riverside point in Wuhan where the Yangtze and Han rivers meet.
placeDesc.Wuchang Bay: A riverfront area in Wuhan's Wuchang district along the Yangtze.
placeDesc.Yellow Crane Tower: A famous tower in Wuhan with a long history in Chinese poetry, seen on this tour from the outside.
placeDesc.Hanzheng Street: A well-known Wuhan street and wholesale market district for small goods.
placeDesc.Lihuangpi Road: A historic Wuhan street of early 20th-century buildings, popular for photos.
